metrics.summary: Fixed `FuncParamType.convert` in src/click/types.py: when the wrapped function raises `ValueError`, the first argument of the exception is now used as the `BadParameter` message (if present). If the `ValueError` has no message, it falls back to the previous behaviour of reporting the offending value, decoding bytes as UTF-8 with replacement when `str()` fails. Verified with a manual reproduction (`--port 70000` now shows "Invalid value for '--port': port must be between 1 and 65535") and that message-less ValueError still shows the value for str/bytes/int inputs. All tests pass: test_types.py, test_utils.py, test_options.py, test_arguments.py, test_info_dict.py (860 passed).
